narrative.overview: The current working direction is clear, technical, and personal. Terminal prompts and monospace display text give the site character; generous pale space and readable body type keep the professional story easy to follow. This direction remains exploratory alongside the README and Web90 backups.
dos: Keep readable body copy in Atkinson and reserve VT323 for display and terminal labels.
Preserve keyboard focus, clear contrast, and the single-column mobile reading order.
donts: Do not add shadows, rounded cards, or new hues while refining this direction.
Do not treat this exploratory direction as a final choice over the saved alternatives.
